Script: `Database/Tài sản/phương tiện -lịch trình/TPT_VehicleSchedule.sql`

## Cách dùng

Mỗi dòng = **một xe, một ngày, một khung giờ, một công trình**. Cùng ngày xe có thể có nhiều dòng (ca sáng / ca chiều, đổi công trình).

Thông tin xe (mã, biển số, tên) **không copy** vào bảng này — lấy lúc xem/in bằng Join `TPT_Vehicle`. Tránh lệch khi sửa danh mục xe.

## Cột bắt buộc (đúng mô tả của bạn)

| Cột | Ý nghĩa |
|---|---|
| `VehicleID` | Xe (`TPT_Vehicle`) |
| `DriverID` / `DriverName` / `DriverTel` | Tài xế **theo xe** — copy từ `TPT_Vehicle` lúc lập lịch (snapshot) |
| `ActualDriverID` / `ActualDriverName` / `ActualDriverTel` | Tài xế **thực tế** ngày đó. Mặc định copy tài xế theo xe, cho phép đổi |
| `WorkDate` | Ngày |
| `FromTime` / `ToTime` | Giờ từ / giờ đến (kiểu `datetime` như các bảng TPT khác; ca đêm thì `ToTime` sang ngày kế) |
| `PlaceID` | Công trình (`GEN_Place`, ví dụ PlaceID = 2 Cảng Mỹ Thủy) |
| `Description` | Ghi chú |

Tài xế theo xe được **chốt tại thời điểm lập lịch**. Sau này đổi tài xế trên danh mục xe thì lịch cũ vẫn đúng người được giao lúc đó.

## Cột bổ sung cho đủ nghiệp vụ

| Cột | Lý do |
|---|---|
| `ScheduleCode` | Số phiếu, tiện lọc/in |
| `WorkHours` | Giờ công. Có thể tự tính từ giờ, hoặc nhập tay khi nghỉ giữa ca |
| `PlaceDetail` | Hạng mục / vị trí trong công trình (bến 2, khu A) — `GEN_Place` chỉ là dự án |
| `WorkContent` | Việc làm: đổ bê tông, đào đất, cẩu cọc… khác ghi chú |
| `HelperName` | Phụ xe (xe trộn / xúc hay có) |
| `IsCanceled` | Hủy lịch (mưa, xe hỏng) — khác xóa mềm `IsDeleted` |

Cột audit giống `TPT_Vehicle`: `CreatedDate/User`, `UpdatedDate/User`, `IsDeleted`, `IsActived`, `OrderIndex`.

## Cố ý chưa đưa vào

Để bảng gọn, chưa thêm: xăng dầu, km / đồng hồ giờ máy, ca làm việc (đã có giờ từ–đến), `OfficeID`, `DeviceID` (join qua `TPT_Vehicle.DeviceID`).

(

)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On;

	Declare @dateFrom date;
	Declare @dateTo date;
	Declare @isSingleDay bit;

	Set @dateFrom = Convert(date, @FromDate);
	Set @dateTo = Convert(date, @ToDate);
	Set @isSingleDay = Case When @dateFrom = @dateTo Then 1 Else 0 End;

	If @isSingleDay = 1

			TPT_VehicleSchedule.PlaceDetail,
			Isnull(TPT_VehicleSchedule.DriverID, TPT_Vehicle.DriverID) as DriverID,

			Isnull(TPT_VehicleSchedule.DriverTel, TPT_Vehicle.DriverTel) as DriverTel,
			Isnull(TPT_VehicleSchedule.ActualDriverID, TPT_Vehicle.DriverID) as ActualDriverID,
			Isnull(TPT_VehicleSchedule.ActualDriverName, TPT_Vehicle.DriverName) as ActualDriverName,
			Isnull(TPT_VehicleSchedule.ActualDriverTel, TPT_Vehicle.DriverTel) as ActualDriverTel,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.HelperName,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkContent,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.Description,
			Isnull(TPT_VehicleSchedule.IsCanceled, 0) as IsCanceled,
			@isSingleDay as IsSingleDay
		From TPT_Vehicle
			Left Join TPT_VehicleSchedule on TPT_VehicleSchedule.VehicleID = TPT_Vehicle.VehicleID
				and Convert(date, TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkDate) = @dateFrom
				and TPT_VehicleSchedule.IsDeleted = 0
				and Isnull(TPT_VehicleSchedule.IsCanceled, 0) = 0
			Left Join GEN_Place on GEN_Place.PlaceID = TPT_VehicleSchedule.PlaceID
		Where TPT_Vehicle.IsDeleted = 0
			and TPT_Vehicle.IsActived = 1
			and
			(
				@PlaceID Is Null
				or @PlaceID = 0
				or TPT_VehicleSchedule.VehicleScheduleID Is Null
				or TPT_VehicleSchedule.PlaceID = @PlaceID
			)
		Order By TPT_Vehicle.OrderIndex, TPT_Vehicle.VehicleCode
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Select
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.VehicleScheduleID,
			TPT_Vehicle.VehicleID,
			TPT_Vehicle.VehicleCode,
			TPT_Vehicle.VehicleCode2,
			TPT_Vehicle.VehicleName,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkDate,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.FromTime,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.ToTime,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkHours,

			TPT_VehicleSchedule.DriverID,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.DriverName,

			TPT_VehicleSchedule.ActualDriverID,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.ActualDriverName,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.ActualDriverTel,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.HelperName,
			TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkContent,

			TPT_VehicleSchedule.IsCanceled,

		Where TPT_VehicleSchedule.IsDeleted = 0
			and Convert(date, TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkDate) >= @dateFrom
			and Convert(date, TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkDate) <= @dateTo
			and
			(
				@PlaceID Is Null
				or @PlaceID = 0
				or TPT_VehicleSchedule.PlaceID = @PlaceID
			)
		Order By TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkDate, TPT_Vehicle.OrderIndex, TPT_Vehicle.VehicleCode
	End

Create Procedure dbo.TPT_VehicleSchedule_AddOrEdit
(
	@VehicleScheduleID bigint = 0,
	@VehicleID int,
	@WorkDate datetime,
	@FromTime datetime = null,
	@ToTime datetime = null,
	@WorkHours decimal(18, 2) = null,
	@PlaceID int = 0,
	@PlaceDetail nvarchar(200) = null,
	@DriverID bigint = 0,
	@DriverName nvarchar(50) = null,
	@DriverTel nvarchar(20) = null,
	@ActualDriverID bigint = 0,
	@ActualDriverName nvarchar(50) = null,
	@ActualDriverTel nvarchar(20) = null,
	@HelperName nvarchar(50) = null,
	@WorkContent nvarchar(500) = null,
	@Description nvarchar(1000) = null,
	@IsCanceled bit = 0,
	@UpdatedUser nvarchar(50) = null
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On;

	Declare @vehicleDriverID bigint;
	Declare @vehicleDriverName nvarchar(50);
	Declare @vehicleDriverTel nvarchar(20);
	Declare @workDateOnly date;
	Declare @hasScheduleData bit;

	Set @workDateOnly = Convert(date, @WorkDate);
	Set @hasScheduleData = Case
		When @PlaceID > 0 Then 1
		When @FromTime Is Not Null Then 1
		When @ToTime Is Not Null Then 1
		When Isnull(@ActualDriverName, N'') <> N'' Then 1
		When Isnull(@WorkContent, N'') <> N'' Then 1
		When Isnull(@Description, N'') <> N'' Then 1
		Else 0
	End;

	Select
		@vehicleDriverID = TPT_Vehicle.DriverID,
		@vehicleDriverName = TPT_Vehicle.DriverName,
		@vehicleDriverTel = TPT_Vehicle.DriverTel
	From TPT_Vehicle
	Where TPT_Vehicle.VehicleID = @VehicleID
		and TPT_Vehicle.IsDeleted = 0;

	If @vehicleDriverID Is Null
	Begin
		Raiserror(N'Khong tim thay phuong tien!', 16, 1);
		Return;
	End

	If Isnull(@DriverID, 0) = 0
		Set @DriverID = Isnull(@vehicleDriverID, 0);

	If Isnull(@DriverName, N'') = N''
		Set @DriverName = @vehicleDriverName;

	If Isnull(@DriverTel, N'') = N''
		Set @DriverTel = @vehicleDriverTel;

	If Isnull(@ActualDriverID, 0) = 0
		Set @ActualDriverID = @DriverID;

	If Isnull(@ActualDriverName, N'') = N''
		Set @ActualDriverName = @DriverName;

	If Isnull(@ActualDriverTel, N'') = N''
		Set @ActualDriverTel = @DriverTel;

	If @FromTime Is Not Null and @ToTime Is Not Null and @WorkHours Is Null
		Set @WorkHours = Case
			When @ToTime >= @FromTime Then Convert(decimal(18, 2), Datediff(minute, @FromTime, @ToTime) / 60.0)
			Else Convert(decimal(18, 2), Datediff(minute, @FromTime, @ToTime) / 60.0 + 24.0)
		End;

	If @VehicleScheduleID Is Null or @VehicleScheduleID <= 0
	Begin
		Select
			@VehicleScheduleID = TPT_VehicleSchedule.VehicleScheduleID
		From TPT_VehicleSchedule
		Where TPT_VehicleSchedule.VehicleID = @VehicleID
			and Convert(date, TPT_VehicleSchedule.WorkDate) = @workDateOnly
			and TPT_VehicleSchedule.IsDeleted = 0;
	End

	If @hasScheduleData = 0
	Begin
		If @VehicleScheduleID Is Not Null and @VehicleScheduleID > 0
		Begin
			Update TPT_VehicleSchedule
			Set
				IsDeleted = 1,
				DeletedDate = Getdate(),
				DeletedUser = @UpdatedUser,
				UpdatedDate = Getdate(),
				UpdatedUser = @UpdatedUser
			Where VehicleScheduleID = @VehicleScheduleID;
		End

		Select Convert(bigint, 0) as VehicleScheduleID;
		Return;
	End

	If @VehicleScheduleID Is Not Null and @VehicleScheduleID > 0
	Begin
		Update TPT_VehicleSchedule
		Set
			VehicleID = @VehicleID,
			WorkDate = @workDateOnly,
			FromTime = @FromTime,
			ToTime = @ToTime,
			WorkHours = Isnull(@WorkHours, 0),
			PlaceID = Isnull(@PlaceID, 0),
			PlaceDetail = @PlaceDetail,
			DriverID = Isnull(@DriverID, 0),
			DriverName = @DriverName,
			DriverTel = @DriverTel,
			ActualDriverID = Isnull(@ActualDriverID, 0),
			ActualDriverName = @ActualDriverName,
			ActualDriverTel = @ActualDriverTel,
			HelperName = @HelperName,
			WorkContent = @WorkContent,
			Description = @Description,
			IsCanceled = Isnull(@IsCanceled, 0),
			UpdatedDate = Getdate(),
			UpdatedUser = @UpdatedUser
		Where VehicleScheduleID = @VehicleScheduleID;
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Insert Into TPT_VehicleSchedule
		(
			ScheduleCode,
			VehicleID,
			WorkDate,
			FromTime,
			ToTime,
			WorkHours,
			PlaceID,
			PlaceDetail,
			DriverID,
			DriverName,
			DriverTel,
			ActualDriverID,
			ActualDriverName,
			ActualDriverTel,
			HelperName,
			WorkContent,
			Description,
			IsCanceled,
			IsActived,
			OrderIndex,
			CreatedDate,
			CreatedUser,
			IsDeleted
		)
		Values
		(
			Null,
			@VehicleID,
			@workDateOnly,
			@FromTime,
			@ToTime,
			Isnull(@WorkHours, 0),
			Isnull(@PlaceID, 0),
			@PlaceDetail,
			Isnull(@DriverID, 0),
			@DriverName,
			@DriverTel,
			Isnull(@ActualDriverID, 0),
			@ActualDriverName,
			@ActualDriverTel,
			@HelperName,
			@WorkContent,
			@Description,
			Isnull(@IsCanceled, 0),
			1,
			0,
			Getdate(),
			Isnull(@UpdatedUser, N'administrator'),
			0
		);

		Set @VehicleScheduleID = Scope_identity();
	End

	Select @VehicleScheduleID as VehicleScheduleID;
End
Go
